title: Docs: Clarify Server Actions cache invalidation with revalidateTag()
body: The current documentation does not explicitly demonstrate how revalidateTag affects client-side router cache versus server-side fetch cache. Needs a small diagram and sample recipe.

title: TypeScript typing for schema validator options is missing strictNullChecks union
body: When enabling strictNullChecks in tsconfig, the FastifyInstance RouteShorthandMethod produces a type error when schema.querystring allows nullish value.

title: Fix typo in CLI help text for --minify flag description
body: The help text says 'minfies output CSS' instead of 'minifies output CSS'. One line fix in packages/tailwindcss/src/cli.ts.

title: Add README link to Turbopack migration troubleshooting guide
body: Developers frequently ask in issues where the full migration checklist is located. Add an anchor link directly under the Getting Started section of the README.

title: Update deprecated console warning in useDebugValue when argument is undefined
body: Adjust the warning message string to point to the new react.dev/reference/react/useDebugValue URL instead of legacy reactjs.org.

title: Export missing FastifyReplyFromOptions interface in types index
body: TypeScript users cannot import FastifyReplyFromOptions directly without deep-importing internal path. Export it in fastify/types/reply.

title: Support custom loading state inside nested parallel route slot
body: When navigating between nested parallel routes with intercepting routes, the default loading.tsx fallback is skipped if cache header is set to no-store. We should provide an explicit fallback hook or preserve the slot boundary.

title: Add benchmark script for HTTP/2 multiplexed stream throughput
body: We need an automated benchmark suite measuring request throughput under 1000 concurrent HTTP/2 streams using autocannon and collecting latency percentiles.

title: Arbitrary variant parsing fails when selector contains escaped brackets
body: Using selectors like `[&_[data-state=\[open\]]]:opacity-100` breaks regex parsing in the candidate scanner. Needs token-level escape boundary handling.

title: Middleware request cloning drops custom response headers on rewrite
body: When NextResponse.rewrite is returned with custom set-cookie headers, the rewritten request strips downstream headers if next-auth session cookie is present.

title: useId hydration mismatch when components are rendered in differing React subtrees
body: Subtree boundary isolation causes the deterministic prefix counter to skip an index if an error boundary catches during concurrent render and falls back to client render.

title: Implement rate limiting plugin sliding window counter using Redis Lua script
body: Replace the fixed-window counter in fastify-rate-limit with a sliding log Lua script to prevent window boundary bursting.

title: Refactor useActionState error boundary bubbling in concurrent transitions
body: In high-frequency form submissions wrapped in startTransition, unhandled rejections inside useActionState can bypass nearest component error boundaries under specific suspense timing.

title: Turbopack HMR websocket reconnect loop during network throttling
body: Newly submitted bug: When dev server runs under 3G simulation, the WebSocket connection drops and enters a rapid 100ms reconnect loop that spikes CPU usage and crashes the worker.

title: LightningCSS integration segfaults when compiling nested custom media queries in v4 alpha
body: When media queries are nested within `@utility` blocks, the native N-API bridge crashes due to unmanaged string memory pointers on Linux x64.

title: Offscreen component cache preservation leaks DOM nodes during fiber tree unmount
body: Persistent memoization of hidden Offscreen fibers does not correctly detach native event listeners, causing detached window DOM node accumulation in single page apps.

title: Docs: Fix broken link to internationalization (i18n) routing guide
body: In app/building-your-application/routing/internationalization, the link to the sub-path routing section points to a 404 URL. Update anchor link.

title: Add test assertion for onRequest hook aborting request with 401 status
body: Missing unit test in test/hooks.test.js asserting that sending reply inside onRequest halts subsequent preHandler execution.

title: Add missing type declaration for plugin creator API in index.d.ts
body: The PluginCreator type does not export the addVariant method overload that accepts a string array. Fix type signature.

title: Typo in ESLint rule message for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
body: Fix grammatical typo 'an dependencies' -> 'a dependency' in eslint-plugin-react-hooks.

title: Implement cache tag wildcard matching for on-demand revalidation
body: Allow revalidateTag('products-*') using a prefix trie data structure in the Next.js cache handler.

title: Support HTTP/3 (QUIC) datagram socket binding via experimental node:quic
body: Implement an experimental protocol bridge allowing Fastify server instances to accept UDP quic datagrams.

title: Add support for CSS scroll-timeline and view-timeline utility classes
body: Introduce `timeline-scroll-*` and `timeline-view-*` core utilities matching CSS Scroll-driven Animations Level 1 spec.

title: DevTools: Profiler flamegraph incorrect commit duration calculation in nested Suspense
body: When a suspended boundary resolves during a background transition, the duration bar is attributed to the parent root instead of the suspended sub-tree.

title: Server Component serialization error on circular WeakMap references
body: Flight client deserializer crashes with Maximum call stack exceeded if a Server Action returns an object with self-referencing WeakMaps.

title: Document how to configure trustProxy with IPv6 CIDR blocks
body: Users are confused when setting trustProxy with IPv6 subnet notation like '2001:db8::/32'. Add a recipe in the documentation.

title: Optimize AST traversal in oxide Rust scanner for multi-gigabyte mono-repos
body: The parallel file scanner blocks on threadpool mutex lock when encountering node_modules with cyclic symlinks. Implement lock-free work-stealing queue.

title: Add note about React 19 forwardRef deprecation in reference documentation
body: Update the forwardRef documentation page to explain that ref is now passed as a regular prop in function components in React 19.

title: Intermittent EPIPE error when piping streaming SSR output to compression middleware
body: When client closes HTTP connection early, the Node.js Writable stream fails to emit finish and leaks memory if gzip compression stream is active.

title: Fix JSON schema serialization for nullable BigInt in fast-json-stringify
body: Serializing null on a BigInt schema field outputs '0n' instead of 'null'. Fix serializer branch.

title: Add aria-current variant utilities to core accessibility plugins
body: Add support for `aria-current-page`, `aria-current-step`, `aria-current-location` variants.

title: Atomic state batching race condition across multiple microtask queues in React Native Fabric
body: Concurrent touch responder events scheduled across C++ bridge can interleave state updates before React finishWork executes.

title: Add clear error message when font loader is invoked inside client component
body: next/font can only be used in Server Components. Throw a user-friendly error with link to docs instead of cryptic undefined variable error.

title: Support custom route constraint strategies with async evaluation
body: Currently route constraints in find-my-way are strictly synchronous. Add support for async strategy return via Promise.

title: Fix sub-pixel border rendering issue in Firefox on fractional DPI scaling
body: Using 1px borders with border-collapse table layout produces missing border lines on 125% and 150% Windows scaling.
